title: C^1 approximation of Lipschitz functions (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5)
statement: Let n be a natural number, f : R^n -> R Lipschitz (with constant K >= 0) and eps > 0. Then there is a C^1 function g : R^n -> R such that L^n({x : f(x) != g(x)} union {x : Df(x) != Dg(x)}) < eps, where L^n is Lebesgue measure (volume) on R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) and Df(x) = fderiv R f x (the zero map at points where f is not differentiable).
lean_statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume ({x | f x ≠ g x} ∪ {x | fderiv ℝ f x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x}) < ENNReal.ofReal ε
